challenge.outcome: The rewritten checklist assigns TMA bytes to complete_tx, phase to each reused object, MMA completion to commit/mbarrier, and tcgen05 fences only to applicable cross-thread execution-ordering handoffs.

PTX distinguishes commit/mbarrier completion from before/after-thread-sync ordering across execution-ordering operations.
